The '''Merchant's Consortium''' was a business association that operated on [[Iol]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] that was controlled by the company [[Tangan Industries]]. The council was constituted of representatives of various companies that had the permission of Tangan to trade their goods and services with Iol's colonists, and the consortium held regular meetings with Tangan in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Haven (city)|Haven]], to discuss business matters.<ref name="The Unknown Regions" />
